note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 209-229; Bookmark #17: Transparency and corruption, lines 934-976) lowercases every column and renames P10A01A1..A11, P10A01A12A, P10A02, P10A03, P10B01, P10B01A, P10B02, P10B02A, P10B04, P10B05 to tc_<lowercase source name> (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares) labels each column, 20/20, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed numbering (P10A01 rows 1-11, row 98 'Otro' stored as P10A01A12A). Not included in the IRW table (not selected by the do-file): P10A03A1, P10B02B_A..Z, P10B03, P10B03A. Step 3b: live items (20; resp 1-5 overall) match Capítulo X Transparencia exactly; the dictionary description ('perceptions of transparency, corruption, and integrity in government institutions') agrees; no instrument mismatch. Unlike the Capítulo IV/V siblings, this block is heterogeneous: P10A01 is a 12-row institution grid on a 4-point scale, P10A02 a 3-point scale, P10A03/P10B01/P10B01A/P10B02/P10B02A/P10B04 Sí/No, P10B05 a 5-point frequency scale; there is no 1-10 satisfaction item and no left-hand framing text. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire pp.10-12 (checked against the rendered page images at 110-200 dpi). Dictionary variable labels agree character-for-character on 18/20 items. Two wording overrides, questionnaire preferred: (a) tc_p10a01a12a dictionary 'Otro' vs printed row '98. Otro, ¿cuál?' followed by 'Especifique____', shipped 'Otro, ¿cuál?'; (b) tc_p10b05 dictionary 'Qué tan frecuentemente considera que ...' vs printed 'Qué tan frecuentemente considera usted que ...', shipped with 'usted'. Printed line-break hyphenations rejoined ('institucio-nes', 'Guate-mala', 'corrup-ción', 'ascen-sos'); other line breaks joined with a single space. Option 2 of P10A02 is printed '¿Poco compremetido?' (typo for 'comprometido') on the page and in the dictionary value label; shipped as printed, not corrected. Options transcribed as printed including the read-out question marks (P10A02, P10B05); P10A01 grid column headers '1 - Muy honorables', '2 - Honorables', '3- Corruptos', '4 - Muy corruptos' shipped without the number prefix; dictionary value labels agree on every option. Structure: P10A01 lead-in 'Desde su punto de vista, qué tan honorables o corruptas considera a las personas de las siguientes instituciones en el país:' is shared by the 12 grid rows -> section_prompt of section _1; the 8 standalone questions -> section _2, no prompt. instructions blank: the block has no whole-table framing (only chapter/section headings 'CAPÍTULO X. TRANSPARENCIA', 'SECCIÓN A. Transparencia en el país', 'SECCIÓN B. Transparencia en instituciones del gobierno', not shipped). Interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' / 'Espere la respuesta.' and routing boxes not shipped. Missing codes: the do-file sets 97 (No sabe), 98 and 99 (No responde) to missing without dropping rows, so live resp is only substantive levels and there is no NS category (unlike the Capítulo IV siblings, which keep NS=3). tc_p10a01a12a rates a respondent-named 'other' institution (the Especifique text is not in the Hogares file); only 27 of 6,886 households gave a 1-4 rating (29 named one; 2 answered 97), so its referent varies by respondent. Skip pattern (verified in source): P10B01A asked only when P10B01=1 (494 asked; 6,392 blank = 6,166 No + 200 NS + 26 NR); P10B02A asked only when P10B02=1 (209 asked; 6,677 blank = 6,497 + 153 + 27). No other source blanks in these columns. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 68/68 valid item x resp cells equal (e.g. a1 1/2/3/4 = 62/1262/2948/556; a7 284/3359/833/118; a11 459/3853/858/76; a12a 3/10/9/5; a02 1175/2573/2056; a03 940/5428; b01 494/6166; b01a 200/249; b02 209/6497; b02a 59/148; b04 302/6469; b05 1..5 = 362/887/597/1124/1396) and 20/20 NULL cells equal source 97+98+99+blank (e.g. a1 2058 = 1934+124; a12a 6859 = 2+6857; b01a 6437 = 45+6392; b02a 6679 = 2+6677; b05 2520 = 2427+93).
